headline: 1,000 trucks. 12 months. What changed.
excerpt: The full operational story of a large logistics fleet running TMIP for one year. Deployment timeline, operating changes, measured outcomes, and what the operator does differently now.
customerProfile: 1,000 linehaul trailers across pan-India routes (NH-48, NH-44)
challenge: High unpredicted roadside tyre blowouts and diesel wastage due to persistent slow leaks in long-haul transit.
solution: Fleet-wide deployment of TMIP valve-stem telemetry sensors connected to automatic maintenance alerts and centralized dispatch.

quote.text: TMIP eliminated 85% of roadside punctures in the first six months. The fuel savings alone amortized the investment in under 9 months.

quote.title: National Freight Carrier

headline: Eliminating high-speed tyre failures across 650 luxury intercity coaches.
excerpt: How continuous sub-second pressure and heat telemetry eliminated thermal blowouts on high-speed western expressways.
metricLabel: Zero roadside tyre incidents in 18 months
customerProfile: 650 luxury multi-axle passenger buses operating on expressway corridors
challenge: Passenger safety risks caused by intense asphalt heat causing thermal tyre failures at 100+ km/h.
solution: Real-time thermal hysteresis alarms giving drivers early warnings 30 minutes before blowout temperature thresholds.

quote.text: In public passenger transport, passenger safety is everything. Zero blowouts in 18 months gives our passengers complete confidence.
quote.author: Chief Operations Officer
quote.title: Intercity Transit Lines

headline: Extending tipper tyre life in severe dust-heavy quarry routes.
excerpt: Protecting heavy multi-axle transit tippers against severe puncture cycles and carcass fatigue during massive highway paving contracts.
customerProfile: 280 multi-axle tippers hauling aggregates across rough access roads
challenge: Extreme sharp rock cuts causing rapid casing failure before tyres could even reach first retreading.
solution: Ruggedized rim sensors with continuous load-deflection pressure optimization.

quote.text: Our retreadability index increased from 1.1 to 2.4 per tyre casing within one year of TMIP fitment.
quote.author: Fleet Maintenance Head
quote.title: Infrastructure & Aggregates Corp

headline: Preventing high-tonnage dumper downtime in central India mining corridors.
excerpt: Optimizing load-pressure distribution on rigid dump trucks operating in rugged, abrasive mining pits with unforgiving production schedules.
metricLabel: Sustained shift productivity on heavy haulers
customerProfile: Rigid heavy dump trucks in open-cast coal and iron ore pits
challenge: Massive hourly downtime cost when a 60-tonne haul truck suffers a tyre replacement delay in the pit.
solution: TMIP edge receivers mounted directly at pit dispatch towers providing instantaneous wheel alerts.

quote.text: We avoided ₹2.1 Cr in unplanned pit shutdown hours by catching slow valve leaks at the shift change.
quote.author: Mining Pit Superintendent
quote.title: Central Minerals & Metals
